decision.observation: 10:20 pm; the farmer did not move south — the bush/lamppost blocks that direction. The vertical cobblestone street is clear at the left edge (x~0.28), reached by moving west across grass.
decision.hypothesis: Moving west onto the vertical street then south along it reaches the horizontal cross-street that runs west out of town toward the bus stop and the farm.
decision.memory: Greeted ~10/28; 405g; ~3.7 h until 2:00 am pass-out (still saves). Farm route: cross-street west → bus stop corridor → farm north gap → farmhouse door.
